title: Fantastic e-bike tour of Granada with Mario
text: We had a wonderful e-bike tour of Granada with Mario as our superb guide. Mario was very knowledgeable, friendly and gave us a relaxed and fun tour, with amazing views and a lovely stop for a cold drink. Highly recommended.
author: 90francesn

title: Segway Tour - Nerja
text: We had a great time on the Segway tour with our excellent guide Kevin. Neither I nor my daughter had been on a segway before and after 5mins we got the hang of it. Great way to see Nerja and to learn it’s history and points of interest. Thoroughly recommend and thank you to Kevin for his guidance and patience.
author: Sez1635

title: Peter
text: Excellent way to find your way around town and learn some interesting facts about your surroundings. Kevin was an excellent guide, had plenty of interesting things to say and spoke very good English
author: H2982TVpeterh

title: Small town/Great views - Pequeno Pueblo / Grandes Vistas
text:
Excellent way to see the whole town.
Kevin our guide was great, he can do English or Spanish.
He has been in Nerja for 30 years and know everything.
"Balcon de Europa" named after King's comment is beautiful.

Excelente manera de ver todo el pueblo.
Nuestro guia Kevin es muy bueno, el podria hacerlo en Ingles o Espanol.
El ha vivido en Nerja por 30 anos, y conoce todo.
El "Balcon de Europa" nombrado asi gracias a un comentario del Rey es Bellisimo.
author: ichicorp

title: Segway tour with Denisa
text: excellent tour with Denisa who was patient with the kids, explained the sights and made us enjoy our first Segway experience! Will definitely do this again.
author: bwalter67
